title: Neko Neko no Mi, Model: Leopard
structure: base powers (full leopard, hybrid, Rokuogan with the Six Powers) + the AWAKENING as the peak
facts: Appearance (One Piece Wiki): resembles the head of a leopard with spots and ears; green T-shaped stem curled at one end
Carnivorous Zoan, Cat-Cat Fruit, Model: Leopard: full leopard and leopard-hybrid forms
Lucci combines it with Rokushiki; Rokuogan (the secret seventh technique) is enhanced in hybrid form
Awakened in chapter 1069: greatly boosted power, speed and durability
Awakened Zoans normally take over the user's personality, but Lucci kept his own
User: Rob Lucci (CP9, later CP0); fought Luffy at Enies Lobby and on Egghead

plan.fruit: One Piece Wiki Appearance: **shaped like a leopard's head with spots and ears, and a green T-shaped stem curled at one end** (drawn without any face).
cast: **Enemy (new, original):** a one-eyed bandit with an eye patch, moustache and vest.
**Rob Lucci:** long black hair, goatee, black top hat, black suit with a white cravat, his pigeon on his shoulder.

**Leopard forms:** a full leopard; the hybrid (spotted, cat ears, muscular); the awakened form, matched to your reference (gold spotted fur, white chest, black hair, white pants, purple armband, black smoke clouds pouring off him).
plan.sets: savanna, peach rays, jungle vines, rocky outcrop, dojo hall with six scrolls, grass plain, island courthouse, tower rooftop, futuristic lab, iron cage, mind spiral, futuristic egg-dome island, night rooftops.
